title: Earth's gravity holds the atmosphere people breathe
summary: Earth's gravity holds down the atmosphere, including the air people breathe.
body: NASA Space Place says the Sun's gravity keeps Earth in orbit at a distance where sunlight and warmth are available, and that gravity holds down our atmosphere and the air we need to breathe. The mass of that atmosphere is a different NASA row on another card. This card is only the Space Place claim that gravity is what holds the air, from the article dated 17 December 2020.

sources.title: What Is Gravity?
sources.author: NASA Space Place
sources.note: NASA Space Place, article last updated 17 December 2020. Paraphrase of the page's own sentence. Public-domain US federal page. Supports 'it holds down our atmosphere and the air we need to breathe'.
